caption: The drawing depicts a round, cylindrical object, resembling a shallow tin or box, placed centrally on a plain background. The object is illustrated in grayscale pencil, with shading to suggest a metallic surface. Inside the top surface of the cylinder, a maritime scene is depicted: a sailing ship with visible masts and sails is shown on stylized water, accompanied by a nearby rocky formation featuring a figure, possibly a statue or lighthouse, standing upright. The waves and water are rendered with wavy lines, and the scene is contained within the flat top of the cylindrical form. At the bottom left of the drawing, there is a small scale marked "Scale Full Size," and in the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature. The composition is minimal, with a focus on the central object and ample blank space around it.
title: Silver Snuff Box
